description: This header file declares validation functions related to the Cuttlefish Android emulator project, including validation of tap devices, host configuration, and host kernel. It also includes relevant dependencies.

methods.name: ValidateTapDevices
methods.description: Validates the tap devices specific to an instance of Cuttlefish using the provided config.

methods.name: ValidateHostConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the host configuration requirements for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: ValidateHostKernel
methods.description: Validates the host kernel environment for compatibility with Cuttlefish.
